text: Take a slow breath in and let your exhale gently unwind your whole body.
Let your shoulders lower, let your chest loosen, let your breath drop into a softer rhythm.
You don't need to change anything, you're simply allowing space.
As you breathe, imagine a warm softness spreading through your body, like a subtle wave moving
outward, easing whatever feels tight inside.
Your breath becomes smoother, your awareness becomes wider, a quiet spaciousness opens
in the center of your chest, feel the edges of your emotions soften, just loosening, becoming
and lighter, more fluid, more open.
There is room here, room for breath, room for presence, room for you.
Each inhale brings a gentle steadiness, each exhale carries a soft release.
Your whole system begins to settle into ease.

You're here, you're calm, you're steady.
And you can move forward from this open place.
